page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with two coin medallions (woodcut portraits) at the top, centred above the text block. No margin notes. Running head at top centre with page number at top left. Text ends with the last full line; no catchword or signature.

main_text.p: [woodcut medallion of Charles VIII, legend: CAROLVS · FRAN · REX; and medallion of Anne of Brittany, legend: ANNA BRIT · D · FRAN · R; these are illustrations, not text]

CAROLVS, huius nominis octauus Fracorum Rex succedit patri Ludouico, anno mundi 5445. à Christo nato 1483. annum fere attingens 14. Hic bellum aduersus Britones mouit: ad fanum Aibini insignem de Britannis, seu Britonibus victoriam reportauit, vix liquidè dimidia pars exercitus aduersariorum superfuit. Rex religiosè nimis Hispano Regi Rufcinonis, & Perpiniani Comitatus reddidit. Regnum Neapolitanum recuperat, principibus & nobilibus militantibus suis sumptibus: Romæ à Papa Imperator Constantinopolitanus pronuntiatur. Alphonsus Portugalliæ Rex, cum filio Ferdinando in Siciliam fugit. Neapolim cum pompa, & triumpho ingreditur Rex. Vniuersi Italiæ principes & ciuitates coeunt vt obsessis itineribus Regem intercludat, qui nobilem & ingentem victoriā Fornouiensem reportans (cùm tamen perquàm modicas copias haberet) victor in Franciam rediit. Sed Neapolis ad Ferdinādū post annū defecit. Rex repentina morte obiit Amboesiæ, nullis relictis liberis, anno regni 14. sepultus est in æde Diui Dionysij ad Parisios. Vixit annos fere 27. porrò mortuus est, dum animi laxandi gratia ex ambulacro cum vxore pila ludentes aspicit. Vide Rober. Gaguin. lib. 10. & 11. & Paul. Aemyl. lib. 10. & vltimo. Latinè scire Carolum pater vetuerat, præter hoc vnū, Qui nescit simulare, nescit regnare. Collegium proftitutarum pœnitentium, hoc Rege, Lutetiæ instituitur: & conuentus trium ordinum in vrbe Turonum fit.

ANNA, Francisci Britanniæ Ducis maior natu filia, patre mortuo nupsit Carolo octauo reconciliatis Britonibus, complurésque liberos ex eo peperit, quibus tamen omnibus superuixit pater. Cæterum repudiata Margareta Maximiliani Imperatoris filia, Annam hanc, prius eidem Maximiliano per legatum nuptam, in vxorē duxit Carolus octauus anno salutis 1489.

page.notes: Woodcut medallions at the top are illustrations and carry the legends CAROLVS · FRAN · REX and ANNA BRIT · D · FRAN · R, not transcribed as text. A stain sits at left beside the first paragraph. Doubtful readings: "Fracorum" and "Fornouiensem" are printed as shown. "Ferdinādū" carries a macron as printed. Several letters in the first paragraph are slightly blurred, but the words are legible.
